parsed.explanation: The quote is verbatim and the objection reads it correctly. In subcase k≥1, μ<2^n, so ∑(P∪R)=S_n−μ>S_{n-1}; the 'dummy' of length S_{n-1}−(S_n−μ)=μ−2^n is negative, contradicting the text's d:=μ−τ>0. Even ignoring that, P∪R∪{dummy} refines B_{n-1} only if R's pieces (which come from the 2^n bin) group into power-of-two sums — never shown — so the inductive hypothesis, stated only for refinements of B_{n-1}, does not apply. Moreover D_rest is never defined (R′ is 'optionally enlarged'), and the needed D_rest≤μ−1 is only asserted: the trivial bound D_rest≤∑rest=S_n−μ>μ−1 (since μ<2^n) does not yield it, and the parenthetical is self-contradictory. Nothing elsewhere proves this subcase (only n≤3 checks and a conjectural remark), so the all-n lower bound is unestablished.
